parsed.summary: Tracing the power, MCU, peripheral and connection sheets, every part number, value and address I can read off the drawing matches the specification (R1=10 mOhm, L1=15 uH, R5=6k8/R6=1k3 giving ~5 V, LD39200PU33R, MIC26903YJL-TR, INA219 at 0x40, PCA9685, W25N01, 24CW1280, BMI088/IIS2MDCTR/MPRLS0025/TMP100/MAX-8Q, STM32H753/STM32F405). The only striking defect — the barometer RESET/EOC swap — is explicitly a logged, software-workaroundable bug in the spec and therefore not reportable. I found no drawing-supported deviation that would make the board behave differently from the intended design.
